trials.claimQuote:
### Chrome Tab Reminder: $2.99 (was $0)
- Lifetime access to Chrome Tab Reminder Plan
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Chrome Tab Reminder Plan updates
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms paying about $3 for the tool, matching the $2.99 price; the mention of free alternatives in E2 does not contradict that price.

exhibits.quote: Useful but too many free alternatives. Easy to use.
exhibits.argument: The existence of too many free alternatives undermines the $2.99 price claim and suggests the $0 baseline was accurate.

exhibits.quote: $3 for a tool to help remind you of things and help you not miss an event or a meeting.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms the tool costs about $3, supporting the $2.99 price claim.

trials.claim: Set a reminder to revisit important websites at the perfect time
trials.claimQuote: Quickly set a reminder to revisit important websites at the perfect time
trials.reasoning: Two buyers confirm setting reminders to return to pages or tabs later, outweighing one isolated report of it not working on a Mac and a complaint about reminder history.

exhibits.quote: This tool never worked on my mac inspite of giving all the permissions it needs.
exhibits.argument: A complete failure to work contradicts the claim it can set reminders to revisit websites.

exhibits.quote: There's no way to retrieve whatever site it was you wanted to visit or see the history of reminders (you can only see future reminders).
exhibits.argument: If a missed reminder cannot be retrieved, the tool fails to reliably bring users back to important websites.

exhibits.quote: I use it whenever I want to return to a page later without keeping 20 tabs open.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms user can set a reminder to revisit a page later.

exhibits.quote: In just a few clicks, set a reminder to a specific tab you want to work on after some time, and this one will do the rest for you.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms quickly setting a reminder to revisit a tab at a later time works.
